status: exploratory diagnostic, predeclared before any null fit on 2026-10-14
motivation: Independent re-verification found Random Forest terrain-only within-group AUC below 0.5 in all five V0.2 repetitions (0.37-0.43). The V0.2 RF weather gain (+0.136 local AUC) is measured against that baseline. A null reference produced by the identical matched, grouped CV pipeline is needed before interpreting any development value as signal.
cohort: V0.2 development cohort only: 45 events, 270 samples, 16 dependence clusters. Original test (15 events / 4 clusters) never loaded into fits.
permutation: within every event group, one uniformly random member of the six is designated pseudo-positive; one label permutation per draw shared by all 9 variants and all 5 repetitions
identity_check: draw 0 uses the true labels and must reproduce V0.2 stability_metrics.csv exactly
summary: median over the 5 repetitions per variant (same as V0.2); empirical one-sided p = (1 + #null >= observed) / (1 + N); also lower-tail p for values below the null
caveat: Within-group permutation makes group members exchangeable. True positives are additionally the centre of their control search (calipers and annulus are defined around them); this structural asymmetry is absent in the null. A difference between the observed static value and the null can therefore reflect design structure, not landslide information.
no_changes: no feature, model, split, threshold or cohort change; no original-test or Steiermark scoring
